# [Document Solutions - Barcode Library](https://developer.mescius.com/document-solutions)

Document Solutions Barcode Library (DsBarcode, formerly GcBarcode) is a
cross-platform library that provides an efficient and easy to use API for
creating barcodes. DsBarcode includes extension methods for rendering barcodes
on implementations of GrapeCity.Documents.Drawing.GcGraphics, such as
[GcPdfGraphics](https://www.nuget.org/packages/DS.Documents.Pdf/).

DsBarcode is compatible with  .NET 8, .NET 7, .NET 6, .NET Standard 2.x, .NET Framework 4.6.1 or higher.

All features are fully supported on Windows, macOS and Linux.
